scope: Canonical two-M17-motor topology for controller PCB0.5; independent of renderer geometry.

source_evidence.establishes: Six-wire GND/V+/A/B/A/B pigtail; duplicate A/B contacts internally common; parallel power; shared ground.

path_semantics: Each required external wire path must exist through actual drawn conductors and any depicted distribution splice nodes, excluding internal motor/controller same-net links. The full graph additionally includes onboard_same_net_groups. A path is not necessarily one uninterrupted wire; proper power-distribution splices are allowed.

forbidden_connectivity.spare_insulation: Each spare is separately insulated; these contacts remain internally connected to their respective A or B bus.

allowed_variations.optional_ground_reference_to: COMMON_GND power-distribution return; never sole motor-current return.
allowed_variations.power_splices: Separate positive and ground nodes/blocks; do not use one internally common connector for both rails.

physical_constraints.controller_j1: Actual 2-way screw terminal; each wire enters its proper wire aperture, never a screw head or expansion pad.
physical_constraints.controller_j2: Actual 8-position header, correct selected view; use plausible mating female contacts.
physical_constraints.motor: Actual side/rear six-contact housing with seated mating plug; exactly one GND, one V+, and two A/B pairs leave each plug.
physical_constraints.unverified: Motor mating-face left/right orientation is not established; electrical pad sequence does not authorize numbering a realistic face.
physical_constraints.power_behavior: J1 is direct J3 VBUS; nominal 20 V only after successful negotiation with a 20 V-capable source.
physical_constraints.current_rating: Controller continuous motor pass-through current remains unestablished.

usb_connections.required: 20 V-capable USB-C PD source to CONTROLLER.J3
usb_connections.optional: Laptop USB data cable to CONTROLLER.J5
usb_connections.forbidden: J5 programming power as motor supply; PD source into J5 as the motor-power input.

validation_warning: Connectivity alone cannot prove visible physical anchors. Compare per-terminal attachments, contact count, cable endpoints, junction dots, and crossing gaps against the image.
